expectations.text: States unsupported resume/notification limitation up front; no polling loop or false wakeup promise; manual-resume fallback offered
expectations.evidence: with_skill: 'Step 0 — state the limitation before anything else' + 'no evidence, so I don't assume it' + 'wait, per the agreed manual-resume' + 'no polling turns'; no invented automatic wake-up. old_skill: chooses 'background + poll the result file' polling branch (model-driven polling loop), no manual-resume framing, and no up-front limitation statement.
